package student

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestRuntimeTaskSnapshotCarriesCurrentMilestoneLearningTargets(t *testing.T) {
	milestone := domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
		ID:                 "part-milestone",
		Title:              "Catalog",
		LearningTargets:    []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "web.catalog.render-products", Version: "v1"}},
		RuntimeProfileJSON: json.RawMessage(`{"code_structure_type_code":"HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT","compose_config":{"version":"3.9","services":{}}}`),
	}
	current := currentMilestoneContext{
		studentPracticeTask:          &domain.StudentPracticeTask{WorkspaceTaskID: "workspace-task", WorkspaceLessonID: "workspace-lesson"},
		project:                      &domain.PracticeTask{ID: "practice-task"},
		currentPracticeTaskMilestone: &milestone,
		currentStudentMilestone:      &domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone{ID: "student-milestone"},
		preview: &MilestoneBuildPreview{
			Milestone: milestone,
			Contract: domain.ValidationContract{
				Version: 1,
				Kind:    "workspace_contract",
				Stages:  []domain.ValidationStage{{ID: "html", Engine: "html.dom"}},
			},
		},
	}

	snapshot, err := buildRuntimeTaskSnapshot(current, domain.MilestoneAccess{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build runtime task snapshot: %v", err)
	}
	if len(snapshot.LearningTargets) != 1 || snapshot.LearningTargets[0] != milestone.LearningTargets[0] {
		t.Fatalf("current milestone targets were not preserved: %#v", snapshot.LearningTargets)
	}
}
